title: Virginia Graeme Baker Pool and Spa Safety Act: drains
edition: 15 U.S.C. 8003(c) (2011); CPSC 16 CFR 1450 (2010); dual-drain spacing from WAC 246-260 and the Texas checklist
notes: Every public pool and spa in the US. A single main drain must be unblockable (a cover larger than 18 × 23 in) or have an SVRS-class device; dual drains at least 3 ft apart.

pool.description: Main drains: two or more, at least 3 ft apart, unless one is unblockable (its cover larger than 18 × 23 in)
